programs_welcome_body_bunits: {{amount}} B-Units have been added to your balance.
programs_welcome_body_generic: Your B-Units have been added to your balance.
programs_welcome_step1_desc: Set your name, logo, and brand color to define your aesthetic.
programs_welcome_step2_desc: Configure bonuses, loyalty rules, and exclusive membership tiers.
programs_welcome_step3_desc: Verify your setup and go live to your customer base immediately.
programs_welcome_nfc_hint: Preview your digital card as you design. Our editorial layout adapts to your brand assets.
programs_onboarding_title: Set up your first membership card program
programs_onboarding_subtitle: Choose your merchant starter kit. It includes everything you need to launch your digital network and physical tap-to-pay experience.
programs_kit_standard_desc: Best for quick launch with standard generic NFC cards.
programs_kit_custom_desc: Best for growing brands needing a fully custom physical and digital presence.
programs_kit_feat_order_custom: Order custom cards from factory (from C$2.50/ea)
programs_kit_premium_sub: Your digital cards go live instantly. Your physical NFC cards ship within 24 hours.
programs_kit_premium_body: Your customers receive a digital-first membership card that integrates seamlessly with their mobile wallet. With the Custom Program, every pixel reflects your brand's unique identity.
programs_kit_economics_body: B-Units power your digital infrastructure. Each transaction, member addition, or balance update consumes exactly 2 B-Units. A 2% reload fee applies to all system unit purchases.
programs_kit_learn_bunits: Learn about B-Units (1 CAD = 70 B-Units, 2% reload fee)
programs_kit_refills_body: B-Units can be set to auto-refill so your program never goes offline. A standard 2% fee applies to all top-ups.
programs_overview_no_description: No program description yet. Open Card Configurator to add copy for your members.
programs_overview_no_coupons: No coupons yet. Press + to add your first offer.
programs_tiers_configure: Configure how members qualify for tiers.
programs_catalog_empty: No item in your catalog yet
programs_claim_wallets_empty: No wallets have claimed this item yet.
programs_claim_wallets_refresh_failed: Refresh failed — showing last loaded wallets.
programs_share_url_hint: Share this URL or QR code with members.
programs_share_not_active_chain: This code is not active on chain yet. Issue or publish before sharing.
programs_bonus_incomplete_rule: Incomplete rule — amounts need to be fixed in the editor.
programs_tier_rule_single_mobile: Reward based on a one-time deposit
programs_tier_rule_single_desktop: Permanent upgrades on one-time high value reloads.
programs_tier_rule_cumulative_mobile: Total amount spent since first visit
programs_tier_rule_cumulative_desktop: Tier upgrades based on lifetime spend across visits.
programs_tier_rule_balance_mobile: Balance held on the card today
programs_tier_rule_balance_desktop: Tier follows the member's current stored balance.
programs_upgrade_single_detail: Single top-up or redeem amount reaches the next tier threshold.
programs_upgrade_balance_detail: Total balance reaches the next tier threshold.
programs_upgrade_cumulative_detail: When cumulative spending reaches the next tier threshold.
programs_claim_wallets_no_claims_yet: No claims yet. Wallets appear here after members complete an open claim or redeem this item.
programs_claim_wallets_not_found: No claim wallets found for this item yet.
programs_kit_consumption_body: Your starter package units are permanent and only consumed as your customers interact with your network.
programs_coupon_share_open_hint_long: Share this URL or QR with members. Anyone who meets eligibility can claim without redeem code.
programs_coupon_share_redeem_hint_long: Share this URL or QR with the recipient. They can open it in the Beamio app to redeem this coupon.
programs_coupon_issued_locked: This coupon has already been issued on-chain. Coupon name, claim method, total issuance, and validity period are locked. You can still update the coupon icon, optional wide background photo (hides tile background color), description, and tile background color when no photo is set.
programs_catalog_item_live_locked: This item is live on-chain. Name{{salesFields}} are locked. You can still update optional background media{{tileColor}}, and description.
programs_catalog_price_required: Catalog items must have a price greater than 0. Member claim / redeem codes apply to Coupons
programs_catalog_redeem_no_codes: No redeem codes stored on this device. Codes are saved locally when this item is published live with redeem registration.
programs_catalog_bundle_locked: Live on-chain — sessions and price are locked.
programs_catalog_bundle_desc: Bundle sessions at one total price
programs_catalog_open_claim_desc: Members can claim without entering a secret redeem code, within your issuance cap.
programs_catalog_confirm_trim: Confirm trim with check to continue
programs_tier_editor_subtitle_single: Single Top-up: set the tier name, one-time minimum reload to qualify, member discount, and tier brand color.
programs_tier_editor_subtitle_cumulative: Cumulative Spend: set the tier name, lifetime cumulative spend threshold to qualify, member discount, and tier brand color.
programs_tier_editor_subtitle_balance: Current Balance: set the tier name, minimum active balance to qualify, member discount, and tier brand color.
programs_welcome_body_prefix: Your Business Lite workspace is now fully activated.
programs_tier_empty_hint: No tier metadata on this card yet. Press + to define tiers. Changes are submitted immediately when you save.
